description: Judira wears a cream-gold floor-length gown with an opaque structured bodice, low square neckline and pale elbow-length sleeves. Broad dark brown and gold geometric woven borders run around the straps, neckline, center front and skirt edges. A reddish-brown layered wrap rests around her forearms. A decorated waist sash has round metal fastenings. An ornate gold pendant necklace, drop earrings, narrow wrist bangles and rings provide high noble detail. Brown embroidered leather shoes are visible beneath the modest lower walking opening. No headgear, armor or weapon appears.
